BrochureContent.Content:
Team Myles O'Donoghue are delighted to bring Woodview House to the market, situated on an enviable and substantial corner position on Woodview Grove, overlooking the green area. Woodview Grove is a mature sought after road. Woodview House is an imposing 4/5 bedroom detached house, with a large garden to the side and a substantial detached garage with vehicle access to the rear and side onto Woodview Grove.

Woodview House offers immense scope and potential to extend the existing accommodation and / or development opportunity (subject to the necessary planning permission)

Due to its corner position there are generous sized gardens to the front, offering excellent off street parking, large side garden offering potential development opportunities (subject to planning permission) and to the rear, there is a charming south west facing garden.

The extremely bright, spacious and well-proportioned accommodation comprises, spacious entrance hall, large living room overlooking the front garden, archway leading to the dining room that overlooks the rear garden. There is a kitchen / breakfast room with door to a family room. A large sunroom and a downstairs shower room completes the accommodation downstairs. On the first floor, there are four bedrooms, main bedroom with ensuite and a family bathroom.

There is a detached garage 10.74m x 6.61m situated to the rear, and, combined with the large side garden, this offers an excellent opportunity to extend the existing accommodation, development opportunities, or convert the garage into a Granny Flat / Home Office (subject to necessary planning permission).

Woodview Grove is a mature sought after location conveniently situated on the doorstep of the Blanchardstown, Clonsilla and Castleknock Village. There are a host of local amenities in the immediate vicinity including local shopping, Roselawn Shopping Centre, coffee shops, Doctor surgeries, recreational and sports clubs, speciality shops and restaurants. There is an abundance of well-respected primary and secondary schools in the catchment area. Transportation links are well catered for with a well serviced bus route, and Coolmine Train Station within a 15 mins walk. The M50 provides a network to North South Dublin with the airport a 20/25min distance.
